reason: The README clearly describes a voice utility plugin providing text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and voice listing tools, with external ASR configuration and audio file input/output.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供文字转语音、音频转文字和常用音色查询功能。
summaries.en: Provides agents with text-to-speech, audio transcription, and voice listing tools.

capabilities: Converts text to speech and writes MP3 output
Transcribes audio files to text through OpenAI-compatible ASR services
Connects to external speech services using configurable engines, models, API keys, and optional proxy settings
Reads local audio file paths and validates input size and text length
